hooks.command:
/bin/bash -c 'exec 4>&2 2>/dev/null
repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0;
[ -x "${CODEPRESS_HOME:-$HOME/.codepress}/bin/codepress" ] || exit 0;
:
fail_open() { printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''CodePress Factory hook unavailable; allowing this action. Run codepress factory update or codepress factory doctor; if the executable is missing, reinstall using https://downloads.codepress.dev/factory/install.sh.'\'' >&4; }
work=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codepress-hook.XXXXXXXX") || { fail_open; exit 0; }
set -m || { fail_open; rm -rf "$work"; exit 0; }
child= timer= output_reader= error_reader=
kill_tree() {
  kill -KILL -- "-$1" 2>/dev/null || :
}
cleanup() {
  [ -z "$timer" ] || { kill_tree "$timer"; wait "$timer" 2>/dev/null || :; }
  [ -z "$child" ] || { kill_tree "$child"; wait "$child" 2>/dev/null || :; }
  [ -z "$output_reader" ] || { kill_tree "$output_reader"; wait "$output_reader" 2>/dev/null || :; }
  [ -z "$error_reader" ] || { kill_tree "$error_reader"; wait "$error_reader" 2>/dev/null || :; }
  rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap '\''fail_open; exit 0'\'' HUP INT TERM
limit=${CODEPRESS_FACTORY_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-3}
case "$limit" in 1|2|3) ;; *) limit=3 ;; esac
mkfifo "$work/stdout" "$work/stderr" || { fail_open; exit 0; }
head -c 1048577 <"$work/stdout" >"$work/output" &
output_reader=$!
head -c 1048577 <"$work/stderr" >"$work/error" &
error_reader=$!
exec 3<&0
CODEPRESS_FACTORY_HOOK_FRAME=1 "${CODEPRESS_HOME:-$HOME/.codepress}/bin/codepress" factory hook dev-loop-init --provider codex <&3 4>&- >"$work/stdout" 2>"$work/stderr" &
child=$!
(sleep "$limit"; : >"$work/timeout"; kill_tree "$child"; kill_tree "$output_reader"; kill_tree "$error_reader") >/dev/null 2>&1 &
timer=$!
wait "$child" 2>/dev/null
status=$?
wait "$output_reader" 2>/dev/null || :
output_reader=
wait "$error_reader" 2>/dev/null || :
error_reader=
kill_tree "$child"
child=
kill_tree "$timer"
wait "$timer" 2>/dev/null || :
timer=
valid=no
if [ ! -e "$work/timeout" ] && [ "$(wc -c <"$work/error")" -le 1048576 ] && { [ "$status" = 0 ] || [ "$status" = 2 ]; }; then
  IFS='\'' '\'' read -r marker code size extra <"$work/output"
  case "$size" in '\'''\''|*[!0-9]*|0[0-9]*) size=invalid ;; esac
  if [ "$marker" = '\''CODEPRESS_FACTORY_HOOK_V1'\'' ] && [ "$code" = "$status" ] && [ -z "$extra" ] && [ "$size" != invalid ] && [ "${#size}" -le 5 ]; then
    header=$(printf '\''%s %s %s\n'\'' "$marker" "$code" "$size" | wc -c)
    total=$(wc -c <"$work/output")
    footer=$(tail -c 31 "$work/output")
    if [ "$total" -eq "$((header + size + 31))" ] && [ "$footer" = '\''
CODEPRESS_FACTORY_HOOK_END_V1'\'' ]; then
      dd if="$work/output" of="$work/body" bs=1 skip="$header" count="$size" 2>/dev/null && valid=yes
    fi
  fi
fi
if [ "$valid" = yes ]; then
  cat "$work/error" >&4
  cat "$work/body" || { fail_open; exit 0; }
  exit "$status"
fi
head -c 4096 "$work/error" >&4
fail_open
exit 0'
